verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the Customer Agent can follow support flows configured in natural language, call tools, apply guardrails and transfer tickets. Nothing in the pack documents the agent asking customers clarifying questions or working through multi-step troubleshooting instead of giving a single answer. Configurable flows are at best an adjacent building block, not evidence of this behavior.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent asks clarifying questions and works through multi-step troubleshooting instead of dumping one canned answer
